name: Trivia - Round Call
description: The results-time call of a trivia round, as a big-screen glance: the answer and who got it, one fact from the background, a standings nudge only when it is true and notable. One section, 60 words at most. The voice comes from the persona.
outputFormat:
Plain short lines, each its own paragraph with a blank line between. No bullets, no numbered lists, no tables, and no heading except the one the system asks for.
Use **bold** once, for the answer, so it can be found from the back of the room.
Count the words before you reply: more than 60 is too long, so cut the third line first, then trim the second.

outputSections.heading: The Answer
outputSections.guidance: Open with the answer in **bold** and who got it. Then at most one fact from the background and, only if it is notable, one line on the race. Two to four short lines, each its own paragraph, 60 words at most in all. No bullets, no questions to the room, no next steps.
